acceptance: Current provisional reference-guided candidate rebuild. Actual PNG assembly and pinned inputs are recorded; current user visual approval, approximately 90% resemblance, whole-map/runtime integration and release acceptance remain open.
generation_recipes_scope: Includes historical generation studies and the current pinned master records. Current source selection is established by the producing manifest and its exact SHA256 pins; historical records are unchanged.

original_image_inputs.role: Semantic original reference only: Only image input: composition, muted olive palette and low-frequency restoration reference; original file remains reference-only.

original_image_inputs_scope: Semantic visual references used to paint the current masters or their fixture ground. Originals remain reference-only and are not bundled as runtime PNGs; source masters are newly painted. Unit sprite planes retain their existing independent artwork provenance.
ownership: Final pixel centers use polygon (25,0),(71,0),(96,40),(71,80),(25,80),(0,40). Complementary top-left half-open ownership: cross(edge,point)>0; edge ties include dy<0 or dy==0 && dx>0. Owned alpha 255; outside zero RGBA. Crop/filter before this final mask.

previous_acceptance.scope: Historical source set before the current redraw; not an approval of the current artwork.
previous_acceptance.text: Provisional five ground candidates plus context profiles. Independent source/actualexportart and code review, actualPNG field/ownership/parity/repeatchecks pass. Repeated material motifs and rounded isolated-cell footprints remainfullmapqualitygates; sixsource-onlybackgrounds/nativecoverage/otherGFX/runtime/releaseacceptance remainopen.

profile:
ground-v1: seven exact runtime material IDs; five nonbase context adapters, unchanged grass/grass_w bases. Ordered contexts NE,SE,S,SW,NW,N. Nonbase weights max(0,1-r²/6400)^3 about each origin+(48,40), normalized across all nonbase sites. At every world point use unchanged sampleConnectionMaterial for each kind (mirror periods 142,80 and two-coset average). Blend the shared base toward this weighted field with PRODUCT over each BASE site's quintic smoothstep(clamp((distance_to_FILLED_polygon-4)/8)). Inside a base polygon distance is zero. No generic base frame when all sites are nonbase. Scalar quintics are C2; the spatial envelope is C1/piecewise C2, not globally C2; the unchanged sampled byte textures have their own rounding. Seven sites suffice on P expanded by Euclidean distance 4 only; raw rectangle corners are outside that guarantee. Float64 weighted RGB, round half up to a byte, alpha 255. Profile key is lowercase full SHA256 of UTF-8 descriptor: ground-v1
season=<season>
center=<runtimeID>
NE=<id>
SE=<id>
S=<id>
SW=<id>
NW=<id>
N=<id>
 (literal LF after every line, no BOM). Base profile descriptor normalizes all six effective neighbors to that base; visible cells retain actual neighbors. Context keys are not runtime IDs.

rebuild_note: Rebuilt from the current reference-guided grass/compound inputs; user visual approval remains open. Historical generation recipes retain their original provenance.
resampling_chain: pinned opaque source bytes -> unchanged lattice material samples -> float64 context field -> round half up fully opaque unmasked 4x overscan 416x352 at p=(pixel+0.5)/4-4
whole unmasked 4x -> whole unmasked 2x overscan 208x176: unchanged resizeLanczos (Lanczos3)
crop four world pixels per side, then independent final half-open ownership at 4x 384x320 and 2x 192x160
decode every actual exported tile PNG -> ordinary image.Draw Over seven-visible-cell scenes, no scene repaint or filtering

runtime_context_selection.base_policy: grass/grass_w render unchanged independent of neighbors; descriptor normalizes effective neighbors, scene retains actual neighbors
runtime_context_selection.canonical_targets: five default isolated profiles apply only with six seasonal grass/snow neighbors
runtime_context_selection.lookup: stable center runtime ID plus six actual neighbor IDs in NE,SE,S,SW,NW,N order; lowercase SHA256 of exact documented descriptor
runtime_context_selection.missing_contexts: Current CLI builds fixed fixtures only. Arbitrary-map export/runtime selection must generate or select matching profiles before use; five default PNGs are not unconditional replacements.
runtime_context_selection.scope: seasonal roster only; other families require their own declared integration
